resources.string: Load a WAV with Slicex markers (or any WAV and place the markers here). Each marker opens a region that lasts until the next one. While a file is loaded, its regions are used instead of 1.wav, 2.wav… for both the chromatic scale and the DWP. Results are still saved in the sample folder.
Waveform with the markers. Tap to add a marker; tap an existing one to remove it.
Example: each marker opens a region and each region gets one note.
